messages:
Priya (eng-platform): Quick sync: we're landing route-policy v2 which changes the header format and introduces per-tenant routing attributes. This is a potentially breaking server change for client libraries. We need a minimal compatibility plan.
Marco (devex): Important: Console dashboards surface per-route spend. If the header shape changes, historical mapping will misattribute. We should add a translation layer for the Analytics pipeline and show a migration banner in the SDK section.
Tess (sdk): SDK impact: TS and Py can parse either shape but Go's stdlib header normalization might drop structured data. Suggest adding a tiny compatibility layer in SDKs to emit both `x-route-hint` (legacy) and `x-rd-route` (v2) for a transition period.
Ravi (qa): Testing notes: route hashing is used to pick GPU pools; any change to token ordering or whitespace can shift traffic. Add deterministic canonicalizer tests and a fuzz-run against batching logic. Matrix: py3.9/3.11, node16/18, go1.20.
Kai (infra): We can add a lightweight gateway plugin to accept both formats and normalize downstream. It should have a telemetry tag to mark requests that used the shim so we can measure uptake.
Priya (eng-platform): Proposal: timeline + rollout gates:
- Day 0: RFC + shim implementation behind flag
- Day 1: SDK helpers (opt-in) + migration docs
- Day 2: small canary (2%) with shim enabled server-side for canary routes
- Day 3-7: ramp to 20/50/100 depending on health signals
Gates: per-route latency, tail p99 token-rate, and per-tenant cost delta under 5%.
Marco (devex): Console UX: add a "Route Migration" card under Admin -> SDKs showing percent clients emitting v2 header, top affected tenants, and a quick copyable snippet for each SDK. Also link to a support runbook.
Tess (sdk): Dev plan for SDKs:
- Patch: add sendDualRouteHeader({ enabled: true }) helper in minor release
- Deprecate: after 30 days, change default to v2 but keep env var to force legacy until 90% traffic migration
- Changelog: clear BREAKING NOTE and migration example
We can ship TS and Py in the next client release; Go will need an explicit shimmable http.RoundTripper.
Ravi (qa): Add integration job that runs new-server vs old-client and old-server vs new-client. Also exercise quota enforcement: if route hashing moves traffic between quota buckets, we must verify no double-charging.
Kai (infra): Telemetry plan: emit metric `route_migration.header_seen{version}` and a tracing tag `route.migration=legacy|v2|shimmed`. Sampling: 1% for normal, 100% for error traces. We'll feed counts to Console tile.
Priya (eng-platform): Also we need to update internal routing policy docs and the circuit-breaker policies; some tenants rely on route stability. Add an annotation to migrations indicating whether it's safe for affinity-sensitive tenants.
Marco (devex): Messaging suggestion: call this "route-protocol upgrade" externally. Keep internal names in RFC only. Provide a single-liner for release notes that customers can paste into changelogs.
Tess (sdk): Code snippet for TS shim helper (proposal):
```
// ts-client
export function setRoutePolicy(client, policy, { dual = true } = {}) {
  if (dual) {
    client.headers['x-route-hint'] = policy.legacyString();
    client.headers['x-rd-route'] = JSON.stringify(policy.v2Shape());
  } else {
    client.headers['x-rd-route'] = JSON.stringify(policy.v2Shape());
  }
}
```

Ravi (qa): Edge case: batching middleware concatenates headers for multi-part requests. Ensure shim doesn't produce oversized header lines (proxy limits). Add a test sending 1000 small requests batched.
Kai (infra): Gateway plugin will cap header size and log when we strip. We'll add an alert if >0.1% of requests hit the cap.
Priya (eng-platform): Action items (owners):
- Kai: gateway shim + telemetry tags (PR today)
- Tess: TS/Py helper and docs (PR tomorrow)
- Ravi: integration matrix & fuzz tests (ETA 48h)
- Marco: Console tile mock + deprecation banner (ETA 72h)
- Priya: RFC + rollout gating playbook and support runbook

Tess (sdk): One more ask: can Console surface which SDK versions are still on legacy so we can target outreach? Telemetry tag should include sdk.name and sdk.version.
Kai (infra): Will include sdk metadata in migration metrics. We'll anonymize tenant IDs in public charts.
deploy-bot: gateway-shim-canary deployed to staging with flag `route_migration_shim=true`. Canary 2%. Logs transparent: no errors in 15m.
Marco (devex): UX note: add a tiny inline code sample for Go since it needs a custom RoundTripper. Provide a tested example to reduce support churn.
Priya (eng-platform): OK team, let's reconvene after the initial canary results. Keep channel updated with PR links. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
